name: @world-office/wo-renderer-wasm
description: WASM bindings for World-Office rendering engine

scripts.build:win: cargo build --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown && wasm-bindgen --target web --out-dir pkg ../../target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/wo_renderer_wasm.wasm
scripts.build:win:note: prereq: cargo install wasm-bindgen-cli --locked (matches workspace wasm-bindgen 0.2.x); skips binaryen wasm-opt, which crashes on some Windows boxes — wasm+bindings emit fine
